method.association_state: per-bubble detection index or -1; non-null indices are injective
method.mutation: reversible whole-frame partial-injection replacements plus contiguous label swaps
method.anchor: complete clutter-free first frame fixes global labels

gate_definition.association_tv: at most max(0.05, 3 * exact-draw MC q95)
gate_definition.association_js: at most max(0.01, 3 * exact-draw MC q95)
gate_definition.credible_set_recall_95: at least the fifth percentile of equal-size exact draws
gate_definition.exact_mass_covered: at least max(0.95, fifth percentile of equal-size exact draws)
gate_definition.path_sliced_wasserstein: at most max(1 um, 3 * independent exact-draw baseline)
gate_definition.aggregate_rule: every repeat in every frozen regime must pass
